MUS_INTRO_CRAWL (id 610, voicegroup title). Starts when the logo begins to recede on the title screen (title_screen.c calls IntroCrawl_StartMusic), runs under the crawl (intro_crawl.c CRAWL_MUSIC) and is faded out with the screen (FadeOutBGM(4)). The scene is about 77 s (3.7 s logo recede + 72.4 s crawl + 1 s hold); the song plays 75.3 s of fanfare, theme A A B A, a soft pass and the settling ending, then loops a quiet 4-bar coda, so it never stops before the fade even when the player pauses on "Skip intro?". The galaxy card before the title stays silent on purpose.
